note.text:
The laboratory is safe when everyone follows the rules.
• Enter only with the teacher's permission, and follow instructions.
• Walk; never run or play.
• Do not eat, drink or taste anything.
• Tie back long hair and keep loose clothes away from flames.
• Keep water away from electric sockets and never touch them with wet hands.
• Do not touch apparatus that has just been heated.
• Never pick up broken glass with your hands: tell the teacher.
• Report every accident, cut, burn or breakage at once.
• Switch off electricity and gas, tidy your bench and wash your hands when you finish.

worked_example.problem: During an experiment, Mih knocks over a beaker and it breaks on the floor. What should she do?
steps: Stay calm and do not pick up the glass with her hands.
Keep other pupils away until it is cleaned up safely.
worked_example.answer: Do not touch the glass; tell the teacher at once and keep others away.

cards.idea: Safe habits: walk, follow instructions, keep food and drink out, tie back long hair.
example: Mih ties her hair back before lighting the burner.

cards.idea: Report every accident or breakage to the teacher at once. Never pick up broken glass with bare hands.
example: A beaker breaks: tell the teacher; do not touch the glass.

check.prompt: A test tube breaks on your bench. What do you do first?

right.text: Tell the teacher and do not touch the glass.

wrong.text: Pick up the pieces with your fingers.
wrong.explain: Broken glass cuts: never touch it with bare hands.

wrong.text: Hide the pieces in your bag.
wrong.explain: Always report a breakage so it can be cleaned up safely.

cards.idea: Electricity and heat can hurt: keep water away from sockets, and do not touch apparatus that has just been heated.
example: Wait for a heated tripod to cool before moving it.

check.prompt: Which is the safe thing to do?

right.text: Dry your hands before you touch a switch.

wrong.text: Touch the socket with wet hands to see if it works.
wrong.explain: Water and electricity together can give a dangerous shock.

wrong.text: Pick up the hot tripod quickly.
wrong.explain: Heated apparatus can burn you: let it cool first.

wrong.text: Pour water on a burning electric wire.
wrong.explain: Water on electricity is dangerous: switch off and call the teacher.
